ClinicalManagement.description:
Detailed assessment of clinical management skills
following GMC and PLAB 2 requirements.

diagnosis.description:
Assessment of:
        - Diagnostic accuracy
        - Clinical reasoning
        - Risk stratification
        - Recognition of urgency
        - Appropriate differentials
        - Evidence-based approach

follow_up.description:
Assessment of:
        - Appropriate timing
        - Clear instructions
        - Referral quality
        - Coordination of care
        - Documentation
        - Communication with colleagues

management_plan.description:
Assessment of:
        - Treatment appropriateness
        - Evidence-based choices
        - Patient involvement
        - Resource consideration
        - Practical implementation
        - Monitoring plans

safety_netting.description:
Assessment of:
        - Clear warning signs
        - Action plans
        - Emergency instructions
        - Follow-up arrangements
        - Documentation
        - Resource provision

ClinicalManagement.title: ClinicalManagement

DataGathering.description:
Comprehensive assessment of clinical information gathering
aligned with PLAB 2 standards.

examination.description:
Assessment of:
        - Clear explanation of examination rationale
        - Step-by-step communication of procedure
        - Appropriate consent and chaperone discussion
        - Professional and empathetic manner
        - Patient dignity and comfort
        - Clear instructions to patient
        - Systematic examination technique

history_taking.description:
Assessment of:
        - Systematic approach
        - Relevant presenting complaint details
        - Past medical history
        - Drug history and allergies
        - Family and social history
        - ICE exploration
        - Red flag symptoms
        - System review when appropriate

interpretation.description:
Assessment of:
        - Clinical reasoning
        - Integration of findings
        - Recognition of patterns
        - Appropriate differentials
        - Risk assessment
        - Clinical judgment

investigations.description:
Assessment of:
        - Appropriate test selection
        - Cost-effectiveness
        - Result interpretation
        - Explaining investigations
        - Risk communication
        - Consent for procedures

DataGathering.title: DataGathering

PlabEvaluationScoreModel.description:
Represents a detailed evaluation of a specific competency area,
including specific tasks completed/missed, scoring, and improvement suggestions.

completed.description: Specific tasks or behaviors successfully demonstrated by the candidate.
completed.title: Completed

critical_flags.description: Critical errors or patient safety concerns that require immediate attention.
critical_flags.title: Critical Flags

missed.description: Critical tasks or behaviors the candidate failed to demonstrate.
missed.title: Missed

score.description: Performance score (0.0-1.0) based on GMC standards.
score.title: Score

suggested_actions.description: Specific improvement actions aligned with GMC competencies.
suggested_actions.title: Suggested Actions

supporting_phrase.description:
ONLY 1-2 direct quotes from the doctor.
        Must include:
        1. Exact words used
        2. Sufficient context to understand the situation
supporting_phrase.title: Supporting Phrase

PlabEvaluationScoreModel.title: PlabEvaluationScoreModel

PlabInterpersonalSkillsModel.description:
Comprehensive assessment of communication and interpersonal skills
based on GMC domains and PLAB 2 requirements.

empathy.description:
Assessment of:
        - Recognition of patient's emotions
        - Appropriate emotional responses
        - Validation of concerns
        - Supporting patient's psychological needs
        - Professional compassion

language.description:
Assessment of:
        - Clarity and appropriateness of language
        - Avoidance of medical jargon
        - Professional tone and manner
        - Clear explanations at patient's level
        - Appropriate use of translation services if needed

listening.description:
Assessment of:
        - Active listening skills
        - Appropriate non-verbal cues
        - Recognition of patient cues
        - Clarification of information
        - Verification of understanding

rapport.description:
Assessment of:
        - Professional introduction
        - Building trust
        - Cultural sensitivity
        - Appropriate eye contact
        - Professional boundaries
        - Respect for patient dignity

PlabInterpersonalSkillsModel.title: PlabInterpersonalSkillsModel
